features: 4-channel multi-directional PTRZ camera (4 independently aimed 2MP sensors)
Motorized PTRZ (pan/tilt/rotate/zoom) per channel for install-time aiming
release_notes: Ingest 2026-09-08 (multi-directional gap fill; discontinued). No official DataSheet PDF reachable in Hanwha's PIM and the product page's full spec table is JS-rendered; record built from the official product-details overview. Verified: 4-channel multi-directional PTRZ, 2MP per channel (8MP combined), 3.0-6.0mm 2x motorized varifocal per channel, no IR (non-R 'QZ' variant), H.265/H.264/MJPEG 60fps@2M, IP66/IK10/NEMA4X. WDR dB, IR, microSD capacity, power, operating temperature, dimensions and weight were not machine-readable and are omitted (not fabricated). PTRZ is install-time motorized aiming (not runtime autotracking); no ptz block recorded.

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.

blue_iris.notes: Select 'Hanwha' (or 'Samsung' on older Blue Iris versions).
